title: Learning Personalized Memory Gating from Delayed One-Sided Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.23812v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-term memory enables language-model agents to personalize future interactions, but a finite memory bank cannot preserve every extracted fact. Existing memory gating policies are typically shared across users and therefore fail to account for user-specific patterns of future reuse. In this paper, we study memory gating at the fact level. We first propose a retrieval-based labeling strategy that labels each fact by whether it is later retrieved and incorporated into responses. We then formulate online memory gating as contextual apple tasting with delayed one-sided feedback, and propose Warm-Start UCB, which combines offline learning from existing data with online adaptation to the current user. translated_title: 从延迟单边反馈中学习个性化记忆门控
translated_abstract: 长期记忆使语言模型智能体能够个性化未来的交互，但有限的记忆库无法保存每一个提取出的事实。现有的记忆门控策略通常在所有用户之间共享，因此无法考虑用户特定的未来复用模式。在本文中，我们从事实层面研究记忆门控问题。我们首先提出一种基于检索的标注策略，通过某个事实是否在之后被检索并融入回复来为每个事实打标签。然后，我们将在线记忆门控形式化为具有延迟单边反馈的上下文苹果品尝问题，并提出Warm-Start UCB算法，该算法将基于现有数据的离线学习与针对当前用户的在线自适应相结合。我们的理论分析建立了当延迟窗口至多为O(√T)时，以高概率成立的遗憾上界 $\tilde{O}(T\epsilon \wedge d\sqrt{T})$，其中T是总轮数，ε是初始化误差。
tldr: 该论文将事实级别的个性化记忆门控形式化为带延迟单边反馈的上下文苹果品尝问题，提出结合离线学习与在线自适应的Warm-Start UCB算法，并给出了高概率遗憾上界的理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates fact-level personalized memory gating as contextual apple tasting with delayed one-sided feedback and proposes Warm-Start UCB, which combines offline learning with online adaptation to achieve a high-probability regret bound.
